title: Method-of-moments correction

Let (ti,u~i,εi,Di), i=1,2,…, be independent copies of (t,u~,ε,D), where si=ti+u~i and 𝛉yi=ti⊤θ+εi are observed, and Di is a symmetric p×p matrix computed from the data of observation i. Assume that E(ε)=0, E(tε)=0, E(u~ε)=0, E(tu~⊤)=0, E(D)=Σ~=E(u~u~⊤), and that A=E(tt⊤) is positive definite. Let 𝛉A^n=1n∑i=1n(sisi⊤−Di),θ^mm=A^n−11n∑i=1nsiyi.{#eq-eiv-corrected}
